issues.on_page: Intergovernmental 50,000 (COVID American Rescue Plan & LATCF Fund)
issues.issue: The same 50,000 is inside the statement's Intergovernmental line, which is recorded as intergovernmental/state aid (receipts[4], p6). Federal grants follows from the fund name (ARPA/LATCF), which is defensible, but the two records give the same money different categories.

The budget schedule row is printed 'Disbursements'. The label and the capital outlay category come from the fund statement p6 (COVID column, Capital outlay 425,912). That is marked computed and the amount ties, but the label is not the one printed on the cited row.

This one Road Fund line includes capital outlay 1,116,123 and principal and interest 167,139 (fund statement p5). The schedule prints no breakdown, so streets/highways is the dominant function, but the line is not all streets spending.

summary: All amounts match pages 1-13 of 13; notes end 'Read pages 1-13 of 13'. The Taxes 3,210,995 split into Property 2,964,306 + Motor vehicle 203,405 + Lodging 43,284 is printed on the Statement of Activities p2 and ties exactly (Inheritance 878,025 is printed as a separate line). The lodging tax on the Visitor Promotion and Visitor Improvement fund Taxes lines (21,642 each, p9) comes from the fund names, and the nonmajor Taxes 43,284 equals SoA Lodging 43,284 exactly, so this is supported. Every other fund's Taxes stays unlabeled, which is correct: GF 3,010,376 + Relief 9,091 + Bond 148,244 = 3,167,711 = Property + Motor vehicle, but no per-fund breakdown is printed. Receipts sum to 6,417,726 and disbursements to 6,899,285 (p6). The roll-forward 2,834,091 - 481,559 + 190,296 lease proceeds + 40,470 sale of surplus = 2,583,298 ties. The balance sheet (p3-4) ties at 2,583,298, which equals the government-wide p1 figures. All detail schedules tie to their printed totals. Detail revenue plus budget-basis sale of surplus (63 + 40,407) = 6,458,196 = statement receipts 6,417,726 + 40,470. The transfers match: GF out 1,628,275 - 234,646 within the General Fund = 1,393,629 into Road, all recorded as other financing. Ending 2,583,298 = Valley_County_FY2024 beginning_cash 2,583,298.
